prompt: Objective: decide whether to launch a smart thermostat. What you've learned: the market is 5 million units a year and the client could win 4%. Latest finding: that is about 200,000 units a year. What is the best next step?

options.text: Estimate how fast the market will grow over five years
options.feedback: Volume is already estimated. Profitability is the open question.

options.text: Ask the interviewer whether 200,000 units is enough
options.feedback: Drive the case: work out what 200,000 units earns instead of asking.

options.text: Plan the launch channels for 200,000 units
options.feedback: That jumps to execution before knowing the thermostat is profitable.

options.text: Estimate price and unit cost at 200,000 units a year
options.feedback: Right. Volume is known. Profitability needs price and cost per unit.

explanation: Volume is estimated at 200,000 units a year. Profitability needs price and cost per unit.
